snippet.title: Ek Jaisa Sadqah, Farq Zameen Aasmaan Ka! | Sahih Bukhari 1 #shorts
snippet.description:
Do aadmi, ek jaisa sadqah... magar Allah ke haan farq zameen aasmaan ka! Kyun?

Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (Radi Allahu Anhu) se riwayat hai ke Hamare Nabi Muhammad-e-Mustafa (Sallallahu Ta'ala Alaihi Wa Aalihi Wasallam) ne farmaya:
«إِنَّمَا الأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ، وَإِنَّمَا لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى»
"Aamaal ka daromadar niyyaton par hai, aur har shakhs ko wohi milega jis ki us ne niyyat ki."

Reference
• Sahih al-Bukhari 1: https://sunnah.com/bukhari:1

Ek ne dikhawe ke liye diya, doosre ne sirf Allah ke liye. Ghar walon par kharch, kaam, khana... achhi niyyat ho, to sab mein sawab hai. Comment mein likhein: Ya Allah, hamari niyyatein khaalis kar de! Yeh video aage bhejein, yeh bhi ek aur sadqah hai. One more sadqah 🤍
